C-byday.note: a negative ordinal BYDAY is correct: not about negatives in general

C-bymonth.note: an explicit BYMONTH moves the anchor month off January -> no shift

C-feb.note: February DTSTART: borrows to January, same year -> no shift. JANUARY is load-bearing

C-july.note: THE CONTROL THAT SEPARATES N FROM M: July DTSTART, -2 borrows to June and stays in 2026 -> no shift, and ical.js then equals sabre/dmfs/ical4j exactly

C-monthly.note: same parts at MONTHLY are CORRECT. FREQ=YEARLY is load-bearing

C-order.note: SAME SET, positive first -> NOT shifted. Only setup_defaults' [0] is read

C-pos.note: positive monthday, same shape -> first year 2026. The sign is load-bearing

C-yearday.note: a negative BYYEARDAY is correct: not about negatives in general

M-neg.note: does BYMONTHDAY expand over all twelve months at YEARLY?

M-pos.note: the same question with a POSITIVE value, where N is not in play at all

N-first.note: FIRST LISTED value decides: -2 first -> shifted

N-int2.note: corpus case 7a381d6a4176's shape: first year 2027, not 2026

N-int3.note: INTERVAL=3 -> first year 2028. The lag is INTERVAL-1, so it grows with INTERVAL

N-int4.note: corpus case 57bd6869b586: INTERVAL=4 -> first year 2029, lag 3

N-int5.note: INTERVAL=5 -> lag 4. The anchor is fixed at 2025; only the stride changes

N-md31.note: magnitude is irrelevant: -31 borrows into 2025 just as -2 does
